name: Flipbox Addon for Elementor
author: aniketji007

sections.description:
The Flipbox Addon for Elementor is the easiest way to design modern, animated flip boxes (also called flip cards or content flip boxes) directly inside Elementor.

Flip boxes allow you to show content on the front side, then flip to reveal more details on the back. This makes them ideal for feature highlights, services, blog posts, portfolios, WooCommerce products, and storytelling layouts.

With this addon, you can add unlimited flip boxes with 5 animation styles, 4 preset templates, responsive layouts, gradients, overlays, and 3D effects – all without writing code.

Live Demo

Explore live examples of the Flipbox Addon for Elementor in action:

🔗 Flipbox Demo Page

🎯 Widget Highlights (Flip Box Widgets Included)

  • 🔄 Post Flipbox Widget: Display dynamic content like blog posts, custom post types, or WooCommerce products inside animated flip boxes.
  • 📖 Story Flipbox Widget: Create interactive storytelling with multiple flip boxes in a single section – perfect for portfolios, galleries, timelines, or product showcases.
  • 🧩 Basic Flipbox Widget: Easily add a single flip box card with title, description, and icon – great for services, callouts, and promotions.

Each flip box widget comes with:
– ✅ 5 Flip Animations: Flip, Fade, Zoom, Slide, Curtain
– 🎨 4 Pre-designed Presets: Default, Simple, Bold, Clean
– 🔧 Extensive Styling Options: Backgrounds, gradients, overlays, borders, icons, 3D depth, and more
– 📱 Responsive Layouts: Horizontal carousels, vertical grids, and fully mobile-ready design

Quickly build engaging flip box content blocks that grab attention – no coding required.

Key Features

  • 3 Unique Flipbox Widgets: Post Flipbox, Story Flipbox, and Basic Flipbox Widgets.
  • Horizontal & Vertical Layouts: Display flip boxes in sliders or grid-based formats.
  • 5 Built-in Animation Effects: Flip, Fade, Zoom, Slide, and Curtain.
  • 4 Ready-to-use Preset Styles: Default, Simple, Bold, Clean.
  • Custom Content Display: Add images, titles, icons, descriptions, and buttons.
  • 3D Animation & Flip Direction: Control depth, flip direction (left, right, top, bottom), and duration.
  • Customizable Interactions: Choose between hover or click-based flip triggers.
  • Responsive & Touch Friendly: Seamless performance across devices.
  • Lightweight & Optimized Code: Built for speed and performance.
  • Developer Friendly: Clean code structure and hooks for extensibility.

👉 View Live Demo

sections.installation:
From WordPress Plugin Directory:

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for Flipbox Addon for Elementor
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin after installation

Manual Upload:

  1. Download the latest ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the Flipbox Addon for Elementor is completely free to use.

Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin requires the Elementor page builder to function properly.

What is a Flip Box?

A flip box (or flip card) is an animated box that flips on hover or click to reveal hidden content on the back.

Can I use text or images instead of an icon in a flip box?

Yes, you can replace the icon with either text or an image.

Can I disable or enable the title on the front and back sides?

Yes, you can choose to show or hide the title on both the front and back sides of the flip box.

Can I change the animation transition duration?

Yes, the flip box animation timing and transition duration are fully customizable.

Can I use a background image or gradient instead of a solid color?

Yes, you can add a background image, gradient, or overlay on both sides of the flip box.

Can I fully customize the flip box?

Absolutely! The flip box is fully customizable. You can:
– Show or hide the title, description, icon, and button (front and back)
– Add links and style buttons
– Customize the title tags (H1-H6)
– Style borders, backgrounds, icons, spacing, and overlays
– Choose between Click or Hover interaction to trigger the flip
– Change animation direction and type (Flip, Slide, Fade, Zoom, Curtain)
– Enable 3D flip depth control
– Start designing faster with 4 pre-built templates (Default, Simple, Bold, Clean)

Can I create flip boxes in a vertical grid or horizontal carousel layout?

Yes, vertical grid and horizontal carousel layouts are supported. Horizontal layouts are available in the Post Flipbox and Story Flipbox widgets.

What animation styles are available?

You can choose from 5 animation styles: Flip, Fade, Zoom, Slide, and Curtain.

What is the difference between the three flip box widgets?

  • Basic Flipbox Widget: For single, simple flip boxes with minimal content.
  • Post Flipbox Widget: Displays dynamic blog posts or custom content.
  • Story Flipbox Widget: Lets you add multiple flip boxes in one widget for storytelling or product showcases.

Can I use a flip box as a static card?

Yes, by disabling the back side, you can use the widget as a static card.
